0.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_000
0.description: Aye? Lookin' for some whids o' wisdom, are ye?

5.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_020
5.description: Eh? What do <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> do here? I'm Captain Jacke─I'm the bleedin' guildmaster.

6.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_021
6.description: I s'pose I don't much look the part, but that's more to me advantage in our line o' work. Looks aside, ye'll not find a stauncher advocate o' the code in this room.

7.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_022
7.description: It was a rogue o' similar conviction what saved me from drownin' in the sludge o' the underworld. He showed me a light in the darkmans, an' the guild's been me home ever since...

8.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_030
8.description: Why not a sword, or an axe? Well, I may've explained this a time o' two before, but shortblades are simply the weapons what work best for scraps in the shadows.

9.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_031
9.description: They're light enough to run with, easily concealed, an' don't get caught on all the bloody guide ropes an' shippin' crates what fair litter this city.

10.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_032
10.description: Yer smaller stabbers're also quick to coat with poison, an' lend 'emselves well to a rogue's swift an' flowin' style o' fightin'.

11.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_033
11.description: If yer interested in studyin' up more on yer dance steps, then go have a prattle with old Bochard. But I warn ye: he'll talk yer bloody wattles off if ye let him!

12.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_040
12.description: Let's get after the rest o' them Jolly Merchants, eh? ...Well, what're ye waitin' for? Ye get a hole in yer beater case, or was there sumfin' else what had ye bothered...?

13.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_041
13.description: We ain't done with them Jolly Merchants yet. Get yer arse back to Aleport, an' we'll get on with the job.

14.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_050
14.description: Ho there, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! The shadows draw ye back in, did they?

15.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_060
15.description: Back from trainin' with them Domans, are ye? There's a steel in ye I've not seen afore... I've a feelin' the answer is “nay,” but was there aught ol' Jacke could do for ye?

16.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_061
16.description: What's this I hear about ye bein' set up for a fall in Ul'dah? If ye need a place to practice yer hidin', the shadows're always thick here in the Sisters. Besides, there ain't no cull as'll be gettin' past ol' Lonny without his say-so.

17.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_062
17.description: Ain't it great that ye can show yer face in the lightmans again, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Now, yer free to creep about in the darkmans fer the sake o' the realm.

23.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_080
23.description: Hah! We Sisters're still deeply devoted to upholdin' the code─the job is still the job.

24.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_081
24.description: Limsa's underbelly's been bloody quiet, though. After we dealt with Aisibhir an' his cronies, the Reformist faction fell to bits. The Bloody Executioners are still squabblin' over the leader's chair, but I'd put me coin on Captain Moenskaet to take the helm.

25.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_082
25.description: As for the 'Jackets, well, we've not heard a peep from the shrew, neither. Maybe she's realized we rogues ain't the wicked coves she thought we was, eh?

26.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_083
26.description: ...What about you, then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? One o' these days I'll have to round up Underfoot an' the Stray, an' drag you buggers out for that victory pint!

27.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_090
27.description: I'm pleased to report I handed the fake scroll back to the Krakens, an' Carvallain was none the wiser. Word has it that a wealthy collector even bought it off him for a fair bit o' blunt.

28.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_091
28.description: Hard to imagine that musty ol' thing hanging up in some rich cove's study, but there's no accountin' for taste, eh? What would that Karasu think to hear his forgery's now a bleedin' work o' art.

29.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_092
29.description: Meanwhile, Underfoot and the Stray can't stop yammerin' about raw fish an' bathhouses. Seems they had a right rum time in Kugane while we were out there gettin' our daddles dirty.

30.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_093
30.description: But enough about us, how do <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> bloody fare o' late? An' when are we goin' out for that victory pint? Ye can even bring along dreary ol' Oboro─if a flagon o' Baderon's finest bingo can't put a smile on that lad's face, I don't know what could.

31.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_100
31.description: All's bob with us, o' course. Upholdin' the code, and doin' a right bene job o' it. Ye know Captain Jacke wouldn't have it any other way.

32.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_101
32.description: Speakin' o' which, I caught Underfoot and the Stray prattlin' on about the natty duds I lent to ol' Oboro. They were callin' it “an affront to good taste.”

33.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_102
33.description: I'm aware not just any cove can wear those duds the way Captain Jacke does, but there's no need to snub the poor boy. Speakin' o' which, we still need to take him out for a flagon o' mead at Baderon's. The <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> him this time, if ye whiddle me.

34.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_200
34.description: The captain─sorry, “actin' captain”─o' the Bloody Executioners tells me ye've had a real time of it up there in Garlemald. Had yer body cloyed from ye an' all, eh?

35.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_201
35.description: I was sent out an' about to keep me glazes on them towers, but otherwise it's been business as usual. The rogues've got to stalk the darkmans and enforce the code, no matter what chaos the world finds itself in─or how much Underfoot and the Stray whine about their poor, achin' dew beaters.

36.name: TEXT_REGSEAROGGUILD_00215_JACKE_202
36.description: Anyway, we ought to head out for a pint one o' these nights! Ye can even bring along that sour-faced ninja friend of yers!
